"When The Ennead made their modern-day appearance, destroying any population centers they entered and calling out their challenge for Ra to come and face them, the heroes of the world immediately took notice. None so fast as Ra himself, who arrogantly sought them out alone to meet their challenge. The combined might of The Ennead proved to be greater than Ra anticipated, however, and he was defeated in a massive battle which left the surrounding cities and desert even more of a wasteland."

​Interesting elements:

Population centers  and surrounding cities: Megalopolis? Rook City? 

Ra arrogantly sought them out alone: Sounds like Ra would be the first hero incapped, not the last one standing. 

A massive battle: No specific Ra cards or powers are mentioned in this battle

Wasteland: Environment destruction? Scorched Earth?

posts.name: metlarcturus
posts.cooked:
More lore-based conjecture:

The quotes on the Ennead cards "Rise to Power" and "Sun's Fury" are from Ra: God of the Sun #289, while the quote from Ra's "Solar Flare" is from #290. Ra is not yet Horus of Two Horizons on Solar Flare, so this must be during the "massive battle" mentioned. 

Apart from Anubis' nemesis symbol, the only card linking the Ennead and The Tomb of Anubis might be "Taste of Immortality," which depicts Osiris and a beaten Ra (pre-Horus) inside a tomb-like room of some sort. However, the grail theme of "Taste of Immortality" isn't very Egyptian.  This may have been before Ra encountered the full Ennead.
